test_name: Jungle Will Kill You Ded tip missing on first run - 45152496-5cee-49d0-b291-f13967e560bc
summary: Aborted because I could not find a cause: on a brand-new save the 'jungle will kill you dead' message shows correctly in the editor. The message is gated to play once per game save, ever (not once per run or per slot), and that gate has not changed since 2024. The tutorial runs on its own graph and cannot use up the gate, and nothing on this path is specific to Steam Frame. The most likely explanation is that the Steam Frame install already had a game save from earlier play, which makes the game skip the message as designed.
